projects.lead: The three residential buildings MEY İnşaat has completed in Pendik, Istanbul: El Ele, Çamoğlu and Maşuk apartments. Each was built with a reinforced-concrete frame, run under one roof from land assessment to turnkey delivery. Every page carries the building's address, location and construction stages.
